description: Full detail for one Sotheby's lot: catalogue description, provenance, literature, exhibition history, catalogue note, images, estimate range, and the realized price (including buyer's premium) where Sotheby's publishes it. Needs the `lot_id` from sothebys_results_search.

lot_id.description: Lot UUID from sothebys_results_search's `lot_id` field, e.g. "bca81c91-e36d-482c-a705-064e06671fb0".
